t: Forge Steel 20" wood hand saw is a robust panel saw, essential for precise wood cutting tasks. The 20" (500mm) heat-treated carbon steel blade features 9 teeth per inch, anti-rust coating and double-ground teeth, to ensure clean and efficient cuts in timber. Ideal for joinery and carpentry projects. The 0.9mm thick blade offers durability, while the ergonomic bi-material comfort grip handle provides a firm and comfortable hold for extended use on the job site.
